name: Stella Pharma Corporation
summary: Stella Pharma Corporation is a pharmaceutical company that handles the complete process of drug development, from research and manufacturing to distribution. A core area of its specialization is in therapeutic agents for boron neutron capture therapy (BNCT). Their product lineup includes SPM-011, a boron-containing drug designed for BNCT, which is utilized in the treatment of head and neck cancer, recurrent malignant glioma, meningioma, malignant melanoma, and angiosarcoma. Founded in 2007, Stella Pharma Corporation maintains its headquarters in Osaka, Japan.
